# Claude Monet — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is Claude Monet known for?", "Water Lilies"),
    ("What field did Claude Monet work in?", "Impressionism"),
    ("What is lived?", "1840-1926"),
    ("What is field?", "Impressionism"),
    ("What is known for?", "Water Lilies"),
    ("What is note?", "Painted the same pond 250 times"),
]

    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
